diagram_math_checks.objects: Q is n_q by d_k and K is n_k by d_k, with positive dimensions as in Definition line 29.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The top input feeds S=QK^T/sqrt(d_k): K^T is d_k by n_k, so the product and its positive scalar rescaling are n_q by n_k.

diagram_math_checks.objects: S and the mask M have n_q by n_k entries.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The S and M arrows both enter S+M, before the arrow to row softmax. Mask entries are 0 for allowed pairs and negative infinity for disallowed pairs; each row retains an allowed key, so at least one exponential is positive and the row denominator is nonzero. M=0 recovers unmasked attention.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition line 35; positive finite original scores follow from line 29.

diagram_math_checks.objects: A is the n_q by n_k row-softmax matrix; V is n_k by d_v.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The arrows from A and V enter O=AV, of shape n_q by d_v. This is the same multiplication and order as the attention formula.
